_comment: Provider-profile configuration for quota-gate.py (t_7da69d59). A profile with parked:true is temporarily out of use: the gate excludes it from recommended_profile candidates BEFORE selection, so guardrail G1 no longer falls back with a warning on every tick. To un-park a profile, set parked:false or remove its entry. Unknown profiles are ignored.
